The Subtask Name: Determine the release dates of the films and compare them  
Agents:  
- Agent: WebSurfer  
  -- Action: Searched for release dates of "I Am Breathing" and "Ulti Ganga" on IMDb and Wikipedia.  
  -- Observation: Found "I Am Breathing" released on September 6, 2013, and "Ulti Ganga" listed as a 1942 film.  
  -- Thought: Compared the release years to determine which film came out earlier.  
  -- Result: Confirmed "Ulti Ganga" was released earlier in 1942.  

- Agent: Planner  
  -- Action: Coordinated the search and comparison of release dates.  
  -- Observation: Received data from WebSurfer about both films' release dates.  
  -- Thought: Compared the normalized release dates to determine the earlier release.  
  -- Result: Determined "Ulti Ganga" came out earlier.
